name: Mundane Paradigm
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 4, occultist 3, psychic 4, wizard 4, witch 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw none (harmless, object); Spell Resistance no

The target object gains spell resistance equal to 12 + your caster level. This spell resistance cannot be voluntarily suppressed, even by the object’s wearer or wielder.
